rooms.title: Entrance Hall
rooms.description: Rain taps the tall windows. Six paths radiate from a tarnished family crest; a clock holds its hands at midnight.

rooms.title: Library
rooms.description: Antique gold light grazes shelves and a writing desk. A violet silhouette waits beside a drawer of torn paper.

rooms.title: Study
rooms.description: Elias kept his research here. Ink, household records and the outline of a concealed desk panel survive beneath the dust.

rooms.title: Laboratory
rooms.description: A spectral cyan pulse travels through a cracked crystal. The silent memory machine has three readable controls and a loose stabilizer socket.

rooms.title: Grand Ballroom
rooms.description: Moonlight crosses an empty dance floor. In a silver frame, the last gathering continues to stare toward the hall.

rooms.title: Hidden Passage
rooms.description: A narrow service passage runs behind the hall. Cold light falls on an archival box, its old seal already broken.

objects.description: 1926: Elias Blackthorn died during a midnight gathering. The official account says accident. In 2026, the manor is haunted again. Inspect objects, compare collected evidence on the board, and question the spirits. Machine and letter controls also work without dragging.
The matched household records reveal a seam beside the family crest. Its latch can be opened.
Four scraps lie in the letter drawer. Read their sentence joins; arrange them into one continuous letter. You may select a piece and a slot instead of dragging.
An unlocked drawer contains four torn scraps. Opening it exposes the reconstruction puzzle.
The scorched notebook is open to the machine operating instructions.
A ruled household book records the route taken by the butler on the night of the gathering.
The reconstructed letter names the seam beneath the blotter. An unlocked catch opens a maintenance compartment.
A malfunctioning memory crystal glows cyan. A retaining strap keeps the crystal seated; inspection is sufficient to record it.
A power dial, phase selector and reseatable stabilizer socket surround a transcript window. Consult the notebook and safety report before calibration.
The gathering photograph includes a reflection of the hall panel and the people standing near it.
The broken archival seal hangs from an unlatched box. Open it, then inspect its contents.

evidence.title: Damaged laboratory notebook
evidence.description: Elias and Clara: Memory retention trials. Safe reading procedure: power level TWO; phase must match the crystal glow, CYAN. Reseat and ENGAGE the stabilizer before any run. A bypass may light the apparatus but cannot contain a memory load. Do not confuse restored power with restored stability.
annotations: The notebook records operating conditions, not the identity of a saboteur.

evidence.title: Eleanor’s reconstructed letter
evidence.description: Clara is to be the subject of the midnight trial. The safety report says the memory load remains unstable. I cannot let Elias proceed with her. I disconnected the stabilizer, intending to stop the trial, not to hurt him. The service record is under the study blotter, behind the desk compartment. — Eleanor
annotations: The continuous sentence joins establish the reconstructed order. The named compartment can now be opened.

evidence.title: Servant’s logbook
evidence.description: Midnight gathering: Thomas Reed left the drawing room, passed the family crest in the Entrance Hall, then took the service route to the Laboratory. Margin: supply circuit restored; stabilizer not checked. This contradicts a claim that he stayed in the drawing room all night.
annotations: Compare the hall location with the gathering photograph. The route alone does not establish a murderous intention.

evidence.title: Malfunctioning memory crystal
evidence.description: The crystal flickers CYAN but plays only broken syllables. Its readable memory is inaccessible until the machine is safely calibrated. The crystal stays in its cradle; the journal records its condition.
annotations: The glow provides the notebook’s phase reference. A flicker is not a complete recording.

evidence.title: Hidden maintenance record
evidence.description: Two distinct entries survive. Eleanor: stabilizer disconnected to stop use on Clara. Thomas: supply power restored; stabilizer remains disconnected. Thomas added: I thought a resumed demonstration would keep the family’s reputation intact. I did not understand the missing stabilizer. His signed annotation records his motive, not a claim that his repair was safe.

evidence.title: Photograph of the gathering
evidence.description: The silvered photograph shows Elias with the guests, Eleanor beside Clara, and Thomas reflected beside the hall’s family crest. His hand is on a narrow panel latch. The position matches the service route in the servant log.
annotations: Presence is not proof of intent. Linking this image with the route record locates the service panel.

evidence.title: Sealed experimental report
evidence.description: Confidential trial authorization. Proposed subject: Clara Whitmore. Unresolved risk: memory load without the stabilizer can destabilize the entire apparatus. For safe recovery reading, reseat and ENGAGE the disconnected stabilizer; use power TWO and phase CYAN as specified by the operating notebook. The report’s original seal was broken before the investigation.

evidence.title: Elias’s final recording
evidence.description: Recovered transcript: Thomas: The supply is back, sir. I wanted the demonstration to save the family name. Elias: The stabilizer is still disconnected. There is no time; I will start the load myself. [Switch. Rising oscillation.] Clara: Stop—the load is unstable! [The recording fractures.] The last captured run follows restored power with an uncontained memory load.
annotations: The transcript documents the fatal sequence. Eleanor’s motive is established by her letter, not by an omniscient recording.

presentation.instructions: Read the notebook, observe the crystal, and consult the safety report. Select each setting; Engage means the disconnected stabilizer is reseated for a safe recovery reading. Incorrect settings shut down safely and may be retried.

deductions.title: A route behind the crest
deductions.description: The logged service route and reflected latch agree. A panel beside the hall crest is now identifiable.

deductions.title: A protective intervention
deductions.description: The letter admits disconnection; the report corroborates the intended subject and danger. Eleanor meant to stop use on Clara.

deductions.title: Power without stability
deductions.description: Thomas’s route and signed service entry establish a supply restart while the stabilizer remained disconnected.

deductions.title: An uncontained memory load
deductions.description: The operating warning explains the oscillation in the recording. Elias initiated the unstable run after power was restored.

ghosts.name: Lady Eleanor Blackthorn
ghosts.personality: Elegant, guarded, precise. Protects Clara and the family reputation; admits documented acts without claiming omniscience.
ghosts.generic_fallback: The house remembers more than I can tell you yet. Bring a record, and ask me about what it actually says.

ghosts.name: Thomas Reed
ghosts.personality: Nervous, observant, loyal. May use only the approved initial alibi until corrected; never repeat a superseded alibi.
ghosts.generic_fallback: I kept the household running. If you have a record of my route or work, show it to me; I will answer what I can.

ghosts.name: Clara Whitmore
ghosts.personality: Brilliant, frustrated, technical but readable. Distinguishes observation from inference; will not invent eyewitness details.
ghosts.generic_fallback: We built a memory device, not a guarantee of safety. Find the operating notes and the safety report; I can help you read the evidence.

knowledge.text: Elias kept researching memories beyond death. I knew of that work, though I did not design his machine.
knowledge.fallback_text: Elias kept researching memories beyond death. I knew of that work, though I did not design his machine.

knowledge.text: Yes. I disconnected the stabilizer to stop the trial. My letter names what I did. I did not intend Elias to die.
knowledge.fallback_text: Yes. I disconnected the stabilizer to stop the trial. My letter names what I did. I did not intend Elias to die.

knowledge.text: Clara was to be the subject. My letter and that report explain why I wanted the trial stopped: she was in danger.
knowledge.fallback_text: Clara was to be the subject. My letter and that report explain why I wanted the trial stopped: she was in danger.

knowledge.text: I thought stopping one trial could still save everything. I cannot turn that belief into an account of actions I never saw.
knowledge.fallback_text: I thought stopping one trial could still save everything. I cannot turn that belief into an account of actions I never saw.

knowledge.text: I remained in the drawing room, attending to the gathering.
knowledge.fallback_text: I remained in the drawing room, attending to the gathering.

knowledge.text: The log is right. I left the drawing room and took the service route. My earlier claim that I stayed was false.
knowledge.fallback_text: The log is right. I left the drawing room and took the service route. My earlier claim that I stayed was false.

knowledge.text: That is me beside the crest. The panel led to the service passage. The photograph locates me; it does not tell you why I went.
knowledge.fallback_text: That is me beside the crest. The panel led to the service passage. The photograph locates me; it does not tell you why I went.

knowledge.text: I restored the supply circuit without checking the stabilizer. My signed note says why: I thought resuming the demonstration would protect the family’s reputation. I did not intend a death.
knowledge.fallback_text: I restored the supply circuit without checking the stabilizer. My signed note says why: I thought resuming the demonstration would protect the family’s reputation. I did not intend a death.

knowledge.text: The recovered words are mine. I reported power restored; Elias chose to start the load. I did not understand the danger of the disconnected stabilizer.
knowledge.fallback_text: The recovered words are mine. I reported power restored; Elias chose to start the load. I did not understand the danger of the disconnected stabilizer.

knowledge.text: I mistook keeping appearances for protecting people. That was my belief; the service record is the evidence of my work.
knowledge.fallback_text: I mistook keeping appearances for protecting people. That was my belief; the service record is the evidence of my work.

knowledge.text: I helped Elias develop the memory device. I do not accept the official account as a complete explanation.
knowledge.fallback_text: I helped Elias develop the memory device. I do not accept the official account as a complete explanation.

knowledge.text: The notebook says power two and phase matching the crystal. The crystal is cyan. The safety report must settle the stabilizer condition; restored supply alone is not enough.
knowledge.fallback_text: The notebook says power two and phase matching the crystal. The crystal is cyan. The safety report must settle the stabilizer condition; restored supply alone is not enough.

knowledge.text: The report names me as the proposed subject and documents unresolved danger. For safe recovery reading, it says to reseat and engage the stabilizer.
knowledge.fallback_text: The report names me as the proposed subject and documents unresolved danger. For safe recovery reading, it says to reseat and engage the stabilizer.

knowledge.text: The recording and notebook agree: power returned while the stabilizer was disconnected, then Elias initiated the load. That explains instability; it does not establish anyone’s murderous intent.
knowledge.fallback_text: The recording and notebook agree: power returned while the stabilizer was disconnected, then Elias initiated the load. That explains instability; it does not establish anyone’s murderous intent.

knowledge.text: I believe the broken echoes keep this house awake. That is my interpretation of our memory work, not proof that any of us foresaw the haunting.
knowledge.fallback_text: I believe the broken echoes keep this house awake. That is my interpretation of our memory work, not proof that any of us foresaw the haunting.

claims.label: Thomas acted to protect the family reputation.
Elias initiated an unstable memory run that killed him.
Eleanor made no change to the device.
An ordinary accident unrelated to the experimental machine killed Elias.

endings.title: Truth Revealed
endings.explanation: You distinguished intervention, partial restart and fatal consequence. Eleanor meant to protect Clara; Thomas meant to protect the family reputation; Elias initiated the unstable run. The full evidence and deductions support your account.

endings.title: Partial Truth
endings.explanation: Some of your theory is supported, but the complete chain of responsibility or motive is unresolved. A supported act alone does not prove the whole sequence or an intention to kill.

endings.title: False Accusation
endings.explanation: None of the submitted claims was correctly supported by its required records. Presence and suspicion do not establish responsibility. Begin a new investigation to test another theory.

timeline.fact: Elias and Clara develop an experimental memory-preservation device.
Elias intends to use the unsafe device on Clara; Eleanor learns of the danger.
Eleanor disconnects the stabilizer to prevent use on Clara, not to kill Elias.
Thomas restores the supply while the stabilizer remains disconnected, intending to protect the family reputation.
Elias initiates the unstable memory load during the midnight gathering and dies from the experiment.
The official account says accident; damaged memory echoes remain associated with the haunting.
In 2026 the detective examines the surviving records and questions three spirits.

events.summary: A violet silhouette appears beside the reconstructed letter. Eleanor’s presence is felt; the journal records the discovery.
Dust lifts from the open hall panel. The Hidden Passage is now accessible.
Cyan light steadies. Elias’s final recording becomes readable in the journal; sound is optional.
The three responsibility connections resonate together. The board explains intervention, partial restart and consequence.
